steps.text: Talk to Martin in the Draynor Market.
choices: Now that I think about it, you're right!

steps.text: Talk to 5 farmers, then return to Martin in Draynor Village. The recommended 5 are: If you don't already have one, a secateurs can be purchased from Sarah in South Falador Farm Frizzy in Port Sarim. Elstan north west of Draynor. Heskel in Falador Park. Treznor south of Varrock Castle. Dreven south of Varrock, next to the Champions' Guild.
choices: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?

steps.text: Return to Martin in the Draynor Market.
Travel to Zanaris.
Talk to the Fairy Godfather in the Throne Room.
Talk to Fairy Nuff in north west Zanaris.
Talk to Zandar in the Dark Wizards' Tower west of Falador.

choices: I need help with fighting a Tanglefoot.

steps.text: Dig for a skull in the north of Draynor Manor.
Give Malignius Mortifer the items he wanted.
Get the items Mortifer tells you to get, and enter the Grotto in the south of Mort Myre.
Talk to the Nature Spirit.
Travel to Zanaris, ready to fight the Tanglefoot.
Enter the tanglefoot lair in the south of Zanaris, near the cosmic altar.
Kill the large Tanglefoot with the Magic Secateurs. You can flinch it on a corner.
Pick up the queen's secateurs.
Talk to the Fairy Godfather in Zanaris to finish the quest.
